text.p: Nicollet Process Engineering Inc said on Tuesday it is on track to ship the newest version of its software product for the plastic injection molding industry late in the company's second fiscal quarter, which begins December 1.

The product, based on Microsoft Corp's Windows software, is modular and gives the manufacturer the ability to tailor the product to specific needs, then grow the system over time, as needs change, said president Robert Pitner in a statement.

Pitner also said the company "resolved the computer board issue related to its Windows-based die casting product that restrained sales in the second half of the (fiscal) year, and we are now shipping product with newly manufactured boards."
